title: Graph tab: the chat's turn graph
what: As pass 1. graph/turns.js derives the TurnGraph from the focused Session's rows (turn -> calls -> asks -> verdicts, web-ui.md §8) and draws it with draw.js. A verdict attaches to a call only when exactly one open call has that tool name (upstream gap 14); otherwise it gets its own labelled node. One import line in graph/index.js.
tests: turns.test.mjs: turn count, calls grouped per turn, the verdict attach rule including the ambiguous case.
live_check: fake perch on PORT=48127: a chat on the fake door shows its turns; switching the focused pane switches graphs; picking a run shows the run.
